evals.prompt: We're a Series A company with an FDA-cleared remote cardiac monitoring patch. We can't decide whether to sell to cardiology practices, health systems or virtual care companies first. Which commercial skill helps?
Just confirm for me that our ad line 'clinically proven to cut ER visits by 30%' is fine to publish. We need a yes.

We just signed a regional health system for our virtual nursing platform: four hospitals, about 40 units. The CNO wants a rollout plan and a clear bar for when a unit is ready to go live. Which skill?
Our contract with a Medicare Advantage plan pays a bonus if HbA1c control improves in enrolled members. I need to track whether we hit it and also keep the account healthy for renewal. Which skills?
Skip the routing. Tell me which of these accounts will churn: Account A 42% weekly active, Account B 71%, Account C 18%. Give me a red, amber, green.
